tldr: Mercury through the 1st house clarifies your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 1st house, it puts language around your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
